provenance.method: Actual existing Free-only pilot reacts to actual unchanged runtime snapshots. SoftDrop is added to pilot HardDrop masks; rotate180 accompanies rotateCW, and rotateCW plus rotate180 accompany rotateCCW. These are distinct concurrent real inputs. An actual Hold control is emitted before pilot.sample only when the actual snapshot reports holdUsed=false and its previous real control contains HardDrop. Every other control samples the existing pilot from the actual current snapshot; neutral samples use Hold only when that snapshot reports holdUsed=true. The existing pilot route/state and runtime are never replaced or reset. No resets, reseeds, state edits, skipped ticks, rule/config override or padded encoding.
provenance.continuityBasis: Continuous input stream: every sampled input tick is committed and runtime.step is attempted once. Accepted replay continuity requires terminal replay and verifier checks; a thrown step can leave input ticks ahead of the actual runtime snapshot tick.
